newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Lower Danish Oct c/a,trade surpluses seen.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Lower Danish Oct c/a,trade surpluses seen.

text.p: Eight economists polled by Reuters on Wednesday forecast lower Danish current account and foreign trade surpluses for October 1996.
They saw the October current account surplus, on average, at 0.5 billion crowns. Estimates ranged from minus 1.1 to more than 2.0 billion crowns from September's 3.1-billion surplus.

Economists expected, on average, October's foreign trade surplus excluding ships at 2.2 billion crowns. Estimates ranged from 1.8 to 2.8 billion crowns compared to September's 3.2 billion crown surplus.
The data are due at 0830 GMT on Friday.
Gross domestic product (GDP) growth for 1996's third quarter, also to be released at the same time, was estimated on average at 2.2 percent, flat from the 1996 second quarter.
GDP estimates spanned from 1.7 percent to 2.6 percent. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
